independent_generation_policy: Only after dev completion and algorithm freeze. One generation request per document, one automatic source-grounding audit per candidate. No answer-performance-based filtering or regeneration. Require exact evidence quotes and all schema/source checks plus audit YES before admitting. Retain rejected candidates and all errors.
selection_policy: One predeclared policy, no parameter search. Dev verifies constraints and observes performance. Freeze after dev regardless of improvement; do not tune on independent data or outcomes.
primary_comparison: qp_combined_r30 vs fresh llmlingua2_r30; whole-message estimated and API-reported prompt tokens; macro key-fact accuracy; paired question bootstrap and document-cluster bootstrap
budget_policy: Use each question's fresh r30 full input as numeric target. Protected spans capped at 35 percent of available context budget; trim residual words then greedily add source units and exact prefixes. No artificial filler; report every deficit/overflow. All ablations share target and repair algorithm.
claim_policy: Report negative results. No confirmatory population claim from small synthetic dataset, correlated questions, unblinded automatic gold generation/audit or post-hoc subgroup selection. Existing test 139 is not an independent endpoint.
